v11.64 - u-100: orkestratör tek bir konudur, artık tek bir blokta duruyor

"Lead agent" sat at the top of the New Mission form and "Planner model" eight
rows below it, with the team, the workdir, six ceilings and the delegation
engine in between — two halves of one answer separated by everything that is
not it. One Orchestrator block now: lead, planner engine, a mission-only model
override and a NEW effort override, on one line.

The planner engine is drawn as a FIXED value, not offered as a picker. The
mission's control flow parses Claude Code's JSON envelope — the decision
object, the cost, the session id that carries the lead from round to round — so
a picker there would be a control that cannot do what it looks like it does.

"plannerEffort" is new on MissionSpec, on missions.start, on child-mission
inheritance and on missions.status. Validated by the same vocabulary a member's
effort is (refused on a typo, never dropped) and carried onto the planner
command line as a real --effort with the same bare-word guard the model has.
Absent — which is every spec ever written — no --effort reaches that call at
all and today's behaviour is unchanged.

An empty override box no longer says "default". It says what the run would
really use and who decided, and "CLI chooses" when nobody did — U-103's
resolution, read one control over. On a member row an empty effort really IS
resolved; on the planner nothing resolves it, so the two boxes no longer borrow
each other's promise.

Still no permission picker for the planner, and now the form says why: write
and spawn tools cut off by name (--disallowedTools), the read tools kept, 15
turns and 10 minutes per decision. The whole fence is in one AFTip instead of a
worker picker copied onto a participant that has no such flag.

missions.status answers "planner" (agent, engine, model, effort, session) for
the first time: every dimension of every DELEGATE has been readable since M-18
while the participant that decides the whole run was invisible.

212 files · 13766 checks · 0 failed. Parity 16/16, gapBudget unchanged (38).
Looked at: dist/render/missions.png, fixtures "form-preview" and "form-adaptive".
